title: $14.7B MTEP 26 Clears MISO Board Committee Vote

meta.summary:
More than half of the $14.7 billion costs spread across 532 projects in MISO’s 2026 Transmission Expansion Plan are derived from large load entries on the system, prompting stakeholders to appeal for consumer protections. 
 The post  $14.7B MTEP 26 Clears MISO Board Committee Vote  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
